description: This file is a script for managing GitHub security advisories related to vulnerabilities. It provides CLI functionality for updating or creating advisories via the GitHub API, including parsing command-line arguments, interacting with git remotes, and formatting advisory data for API requests.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments into an object.

methods.name: runGh
methods.description: Executes the 'gh' CLI command with provided arguments.

methods.name: deriveRepoFromOrigin
methods.description: Derives the GitHub repository identifier from the git remote origin.

methods.name: parseGhsaId
methods.description: Extracts the GHSA identifier from a given string.

methods.name: writeTempJson
methods.description: Creates a temporary JSON file with provided data and returns its path.
